# Collaborators

```{r setup}
library(googlesheets4)
SHEET_URL <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Dp-nPNbnPlmQO6wBTQGJjjBxrBYUhpCzCdMcC0PJceY/edit?gid=0#gid=0"

##LOADING IN DATA
gs4_deauth()

people <- tryCatch(
  read_sheet(SHEET_URL),
  error = function(e) {
    message("Could not load sheet. Using sample data instead.\n", e$message)
    NULL
  }
)

```

```{r}
library(DT)

datatable(
  people,
  filter = "top",        # adds column filter boxes
  options = list(
    pageLength = 10,      # 10 entries per page
    lengthChange = FALSE  # hides the "show X entries" dropdown, optional
  )
)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(maps)

# World map as a plain data.frame (for polygons)
world_map <- map_data("world")

data("world.cities")

# Your data
df <- data.frame(city = people$City,
                 country = people$Country)

df <- merge(
  df,
  world.cities[, c("name", "country.etc", "lat", "long")],
  by.x = c("city", "country"),
  by.y = c("name", "country.etc"),
  all.x = TRUE
)
names(df)[names(df) == "long"] <- "lon"

df <- na.omit(df)

# Plot
ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = world_map, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
               fill = "grey95", color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_point(data = df, aes(x = lon, y = lat, colour = country),
              size = 2) +
  coord_fixed(xlim = c(-140, 40), ylim = c(-40, 70), ratio = 1.3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank())
```
